title: Kummer class of a Laurent monomial
statement: Over an algebraically closed field Omega, let m>0 kill a commutative ring A, let F be any module sheaf on the affine line, and let f:mu_m to underlying F be any coefficient map. For the Ext-normalized Kummer class of [def-pur-rank-one-local-data], kappa(c t^r)=r kappa(t) for every c in Omega units and every integer r.

proof.text: The class is the composite of additive homomorphisms: represented sections, Ext in degree zero, composition with the Kummer extension, coefficient postcomposition and inverse comparison maps. Every c has an m-th root. Its constant pullback therefore has zero class since m kills every A-module. Additivity sends the r-th power of t to r times its class, for all integers r.

theorem kummer_monomial
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (m : ℕ) (hmpos : 0 < m) (hA : (m : A) = 0)
    (F : Sheaf (Line (Spec (.of Ω))).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (hm : IsUnit (m : Γ(Line (Spec (.of Ω)), ⊤)))
    (f : (Line (Spec (.of Ω))).rootsOfUnitySheaf m ⟶
      (Etale.moduleAbelianForget A (Line (Spec (.of Ω)))).obj F)
    (c : Ωˣ) (r : ℤ) :
    kummerClass A _ (openObject (Spec (.of Ω))) F m hm f
        (constantUnit Ω c * coordinateUnit (Spec (.of Ω)) ^ r) =
      r • kummerClass A _ (openObject (Spec (.of Ω))) F m hm f
        (coordinateUnit (Spec (.of Ω)))
